kevin (Presales): Heads-up: Prospect (AcmeRetail) wants a 1-week POC. Requirements: websocket streaming from our SDKs, function/tool calling for inventory lookups with structured JSON return, EU data residency + BYOK, and rough committed pricing for 10k qps. Any immediate blockers?
rachel (Eng): Node/Python OK for streaming events (token, function_call, function_result). Rust currently exposes raw frames only; we need to emit event enums for function_call/result. Small change but nontrivial for safe parsing.
mina (Solutions): For the demo we can provide a lightweight Rust shim that converts frames into an enum + serde_json::Value for function results. I can draft the crate and README.
kevin (Presales): They prefer websocket (lower tail latency) and want to show partial tokens updating the UI while the backend performs the inventory function call. Can we do function_call mid-stream?
rachel (Eng): Yes. Flow: stream tokens -> engine emits function_call event with args -> client calls internal inventory API -> client sends function_result back on the same session -> final function_result event with full structured JSON. We'll include Node and Rust examples.
ben (Security): Checklist: SOC2 available; BYOK via Dedicated KMS passthrough or Private HSM supported; EU residency via eu-west region or Private VPC; logs retention default 30d but configurable for Private. If they want Dedicated test infra, need PO + security scoping.
mina (Solutions): Pricing note: 10k qps depends heavily on tokens per request. For POC propose two options: (A) scaled POC at 500 qps to validate integration (recommended) or (B) full-capacity proposal (Dedicated cluster estimate ~6x A100 equiv); will produce numbers once avg tokens/request confirmed. Offer 30-50% dev discount for 3 months.
kevin (Presales): Action items: 1) Ill confirm avg tokens/request and % streaming with Acme 2) Mina to open repo + Rust shim + README 3) Ben to share SOC2 link + BYOK/runbook 4) Rachel to push Node+Rust minimal examples and event names.
